claim: The GOP lawyer who helped Kanye West get on the ballot in Wisconsin USA is actively working for Donald Trump's campaign.
evidence: Lane Ruhland Ruhland recently represented the Trump campaign in its lawsuit to force Priorities USA, a Democratic super-PAC, to pull an anti-Trump ad off the airwaves. She was in court representing the Trump campaign just last week.
